title: FoundationOS Server
acceptance: Launch the v0.1 loopback server with a versioned store and first-run admin. Invite members, sign in and revoke sessions, and verify private hierarchical homes, restart, boundary refusals, uniform errors, status and logs. Verify the published OpenAPI contract and the Windows launcher.
evidence: The owner confirmed all server delivery belongs to PI-01 and v0.1. Sprints 1–4 record the initial server slice and sprints 5–9 record the completed server. Older review evidence using the temporary v0.2 label is historical. On 26 November 2026 the relocated v0.1 server passed 14 server and contract tests covering 12 operations and 40 documented responses, Windows launcher acceptance, and the browser status check. The v0.1 Manual PDF was regenerated.
